protocol.threshold: source-training score median for every model and protocol
protocol.soft_truncation: equal_mean_c15 clips shared oriented coordinates at fixed c=1.5 within its scoring rule; learned models receive the same unmodified coordinates
protocol.internal_aggregation: fold-macro AUROC/AP; pooled decisions across 5 repeats
protocol.external_calibration: source_frozen is inductive; target_standardized/target_aligned are unlabeled batch adaptation

bootstrap.type: paired subject-level Dirichlet, conditional on fitted scores

protocol.source_parameters: Re-selected inside each outer training fold; full-source selection reused across external protocols
